CustomObject.label: Instagram Session
CustomObject.description: Maps Instagram sender IDs to Agentforce Agent API session IDs. Used by the Instagram webhook handler to maintain conversation continuity.

fields.label: Sender ID
fields.description: The Instagram-scoped user ID (IGSID). This is the unique key for session lookup.

fields.label: Agent Session ID
fields.description: The session ID returned by the Agentforce Agent API when a new session was created.

fields.label: Last Sequence ID
fields.description: Tracks the message sequence number for the Agent API.

fields.label: Last Activity
fields.description: When the last message was processed for this session. Sessions older than 30 minutes are expired.
